cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.16)
# round70: added C (before only CXX) — needed because the "raw" code
# generated by wayland-scanner for wp_presentation (see below,
# qt_generate_wayland_protocol_server_sources) is a .c file, and
# without this declaration CMake does not enable a C compiler
# for the project at all: the file was generated but never compiled (no
# visible error in configure, only a final binary that does not
# link). VERIFIED in this session by reproducing exactly the same
# problem in a test environment.
project(VoltaOS VERSION 1.0 LANGUAGES CXX C)

# The project uses a Qt private module on purpose (diagnostic probe): no warning at every configure.
set(QT_NO_PRIVATE_MODULE_WARNING ON)

set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD 17)
set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD_REQUIRED ON)

find_package(Qt6 6.5 REQUIRED COMPONENTS Core Gui Qml Quick DBus)
qt_standard_project_setup()

find_package(Qt6 REQUIRED COMPONENTS WebEngineQuick WebSockets Network)
find_package(Qt6 REQUIRED COMPONENTS Quick3D)
find_package(Qt6 REQUIRED COMPONENTS LinguistTools)

find_package(Qt6 REQUIRED COMPONENTS OpenGL)
find_package(PkgConfig REQUIRED)
find_package(Qt6 REQUIRED COMPONENTS Positioning)
find_package(Qt6 REQUIRED COMPONENTS Location)
find_package(X11 REQUIRED)

# Official Qt on-screen keyboard: now a required component (no longer
# optional) — it is a permanent feature of the app, not an extra. If
# it is missing on the build system, the build stops with a clear error
# instead of silently disabling the keyboard (the bug we
# diagnosed: CMake cache that did not find it even after installation).
find_package(Qt6 REQUIRED COMPONENTS VirtualKeyboard)
set(VOLTA_EXTRA_QML_FILES qml/VoltaInputPanel.qml)

# round70: moved HERE (before it was only further below, near the links) — the
# function qt_generate_wayland_protocol_server_sources() used just below
# for wp_presentation is provided by the CMake module of
# Qt6WaylandCompositor itself, so it must already have been found BEFORE
# calling it. The original line is left further below (now redundant but
# harmless: a repeated find_package with the exact same component does
# nothing the second time) so as not to touch anything else in that section.
find_package(Qt6 OPTIONAL_COMPONENTS WaylandCompositor QUIET)

# ── Native Android Auto (src/androidauto) ─────────────────────────────────────
# The messages of the protocol (third_party/aap_protobuf, from the aasdk library, GPLv3) are compiled
# once in their own library; the head unit certificate is baked into AaCert.cpp.
find_package(OpenSSL REQUIRED)
include(third_party/aap_protobuf/AapProtobuf.cmake)
file(READ third_party/aap_cert/headunit.crt AA_CERT_PEM)
file(READ third_party/aap_cert/headunit.key AA_KEY_PEM)
configure_file(src/androidauto/AaCert.cpp.in ${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/AaCert.cpp @ONLY)
set_property(DIRECTORY APPEND PROPERTY CMAKE_CONFIGURE_DEPENDS third_party/aap_cert/headunit.crt third_party/aap_cert/headunit.key)

# ── Executable ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
qt_add_executable(VoltaOS
    src/main.cpp
    src/core/SystemHelper.cpp
    src/core/SetupManager.cpp
    src/core/SetupManager.h
    src/core/UpdateManager.cpp
    src/core/UpdateManager.h
    src/androidauto/AaFraming.cpp
    src/androidauto/AaTls.cpp
    src/androidauto/AaSession.cpp
    src/androidauto/AaSession.h
    src/androidauto/AaUsb.cpp
    src/androidauto/AaClient.cpp
    src/androidauto/AaClient.h
    ${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/AaCert.cpp
    src/core/LanguageManager.cpp
    src/core/CarModelManager.cpp
    src/core/ServiceManager.cpp
    src/core/ServiceManager.h
    src/core/LanguageManager.h
    src/core/CarModelManager.h
    src/phone/PhoneManager.cpp
    src/phone/PhoneManager.h
    src/nav/NavigationManager.cpp
    src/nav/NavigationManager.h
    src/nav/GpsService.cpp
    src/nav/GpsService.h
    src/carlink/CarlinkDongle.cpp
    src/carlink/CarlinkDongle.h
    src/carlink/CarVideoDecoder.cpp
    src/carlink/CarVideoDecoder.h
    src/carlink/CarAudio.h
    src/media/MprisManager.cpp
    src/media/MprisManager.h
    src/wayland/VoltaPresentation.cpp
    src/wayland/VoltaRelativePointer.cpp
    src/wayland/VoltaPointerConstraints.cpp
)
# The #include lines stay "SystemHelper.h" etc.: the subfolders of src/ are in the path
target_include_directories(VoltaOS PRIVATE
    src src/core src/media src/phone src/nav src/wayland src/carlink)

# ── Missing Wayland protocols, known cause of gamescope's headless
# fallback (round56-58/67/70, then round72: read the REAL source code
# of gamescope — src/Backends/WaylandBackend.cpp, CWaylandBackend::Init() —
# the check that makes "xdg_backend: Couldn't create Wayland
# objects." richiede TUTTI insieme: wl_compositor, wl_subcompositor,
# xdg_wm_base, zwp_linux_dmabuf_v1, wp_viewporter, wp_presentation,
# zwp_relative_pointer_manager_v1, zwp_pointer_constraints_v1, wl_shm).
# wp_presentation (round70) was not enough on its own: THESE two pointer protocols
# were ALSO missing. See VoltaPresentation.h/VoltaRelativePointer.h/
# VoltaPointerConstraints.h for the full details of each — none
# of the three has a public or private header in this Qt installation,
# so we implement them from scratch starting from the official XML specs
# (system package "wayland-protocols"), with the exact same public and documented
# mechanism by which Qt itself generates xdg-shell/
# xdg-decoration for this same project. zwp_linux_dmabuf_v1 instead
# we do NOT generate here: Qt already provides it internally (plugin
# "qt-wayland-compositor-linux-dmabuf-unstable-v1"), gated dietro
# the compositor's EGL initialization — see the QT_XCB_GL_INTEGRATION fix
# in main.cpp, same round72.
#
# Guarded by if(Qt6WaylandCompositor_FOUND): qt_generate_wayland_protocol_
# server_sources() is provided by the CMake module of Qt6WaylandCompositor
# itself (found above) — without that component the function does not
# even exist, same principle already used for the link further below in
# this file, we do not introduce a new way of handling optionality.
if(Qt6WaylandCompositor_FOUND)
    find_package(PkgConfig REQUIRED)
    pkg_check_modules(WaylandProtocols REQUIRED wayland-protocols)
    pkg_get_variable(WaylandProtocols_DATADIR wayland-protocols pkgdatadir)
    set(VOLTA_PRESENTATION_TIME_XML "${WaylandProtocols_DATADIR}/stable/presentation-time/presentation-time.xml")
    # round72: two more protocols, same system package.
    set(VOLTA_RELATIVE_POINTER_XML "${WaylandProtocols_DATADIR}/unstable/relative-pointer/relative-pointer-unstable-v1.xml")
    set(VOLTA_POINTER_CONSTRAINTS_XML "${WaylandProtocols_DATADIR}/unstable/pointer-constraints/pointer-constraints-unstable-v1.xml")
    foreach(_volta_proto_xml IN ITEMS
            "${VOLTA_PRESENTATION_TIME_XML}"
            "${VOLTA_RELATIVE_POINTER_XML}"
            "${VOLTA_POINTER_CONSTRAINTS_XML}")
        if(NOT EXISTS "${_volta_proto_xml}")
            message(FATAL_ERROR "Spec protocollo Wayland non trovato (${_volta_proto_xml}) — installa il pacchetto di sistema 'wayland-protocols' (su Fedora: sudo dnf install wayland-protocols-devel)")
        endif()
    endforeach()
    qt_generate_wayland_protocol_server_sources(VoltaOS
        FILES
            ${VOLTA_PRESENTATION_TIME_XML}
            ${VOLTA_RELATIVE_POINTER_XML}
            ${VOLTA_POINTER_CONSTRAINTS_XML}
    )
    # The macro above ALSO generates the "raw" C code of wayland-scanner
    # for each protocol (wayland-<name>-protocol.c, in the
    # build) — definisce i simboli "wp_presentation_interface"/
    # "zwp_relative_pointer_manager_v1_interface"/
    # "zwp_pointer_constraints_v1_interface" that the C++ wrappers use
    # (wl_resource_instance_of) but does NOT add them by itself to the
    # target's compilation. VERIFIED in this session (round70b):
    # without these lines the files are generated but never compiled, and the
    # final binary link fails with "undefined reference" —
    # no error before, only at the end of the build. File names decided by
    # wayland-scanner itself (wayland-<xml name without extension>-protocol.c),
    # path decided by the Qt macro (verified: the current build folder).
    target_sources(VoltaOS PRIVATE
        ${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/wayland-presentation-time-protocol.c
        ${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/wayland-relative-pointer-unstable-v1-protocol.c
        ${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/wayland-pointer-constraints-unstable-v1-protocol.c
    )
    # The generated code (both the "raw" C part of wayland-scanner and
    # nostri VoltaPresentation.cpp/VoltaRelativePointer.cpp/
    # VoltaPointerConstraints.cpp) calls libwayland-server functions
    # directly (e.g. wl_resource_destroy) — unlike the rest
    # of the project, which always goes through Qt classes and never had
    # to link it explicitly. VERIFIED in this session:
    # without this link the final binary link fails with
    # "undefined reference to wl_resource_instance_of"/"DSO missing from
    # command line" (Qt6WaylandCompositor does not re-export it as a public
    # dependency — confirmed with "pkg-config --print-requires").
    pkg_check_modules(WaylandServer REQUIRED wayland-server)
endif()

# ── QML module (File leggeri e sorgenti) ──────────────────────────────────────
# ── Assets: on disk they are in assets/, but in the Qt resources they keep the usual
#    path (qrc:/VoltaApp/icons/..., /car3d/..., /fonts/..., /images/...),
#    so the QML does not change.
file(GLOB_RECURSE VOLTA_ASSET_FILES RELATIVE ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR} CONFIGURE_DEPENDS
    ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/assets/icons/*
    ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/assets/images/*
    ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/assets/fonts/*
    ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/assets/car3d/*)
foreach(_f IN LISTS VOLTA_ASSET_FILES)
    string(REGEX REPLACE "^assets/" "" _alias "${_f}")
    set_source_files_properties("${_f}" PROPERTIES QT_RESOURCE_ALIAS "${_alias}")
endforeach()

set_source_files_properties(qml/Theme.qml PROPERTIES QT_QML_SINGLETON_TYPE TRUE)
set_source_files_properties(qml/KeyboardSettings.qml PROPERTIES QT_QML_SINGLETON_TYPE TRUE)
set_source_files_properties(qml/WebApps.qml PROPERTIES QT_QML_SINGLETON_TYPE TRUE)
file(GLOB VOLTA_CARBODY_MESHES RELATIVE ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR} CONFIGURE_DEPENDS
    ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/qml/carbody_meshes/*.mesh
    ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/qml/carwheel_meshes/*.mesh)

# Private Qt Quick APIs: only for the VOLTA_DIRTY diagnostic probe (DirtyProbe.h)
# Optional: some distributions (e.g. Debian) do not provide it, in that case the probe is disabled.
find_package(Qt6 OPTIONAL_COMPONENTS QuickPrivate QUIET)
if(TARGET Qt6::QuickPrivate)
    target_link_libraries(VoltaOS PRIVATE Qt6::QuickPrivate)
    target_compile_definitions(VoltaOS PRIVATE VOLTA_HAS_DIRTYPROBE)
endif()
target_link_libraries(VoltaOS PRIVATE Qt6::OpenGL aap_protobuf OpenSSL::SSL OpenSSL::Crypto)
target_include_directories(VoltaOS PRIVATE src/androidauto)
# version shown in Settings > Updates and compared with the latest GitHub release
target_compile_definitions(VoltaOS PRIVATE VOLTA_VERSION="${PROJECT_VERSION}")

# CarPlay / Android Auto via dongle Carlinkit (src/carlink): USB, decoder H.264, audio e video Qt
find_package(Qt6 REQUIRED COMPONENTS Multimedia)
pkg_check_modules(LIBUSB REQUIRED IMPORTED_TARGET libusb-1.0)
pkg_check_modules(AVCODEC REQUIRED IMPORTED_TARGET libavcodec libavutil)
target_link_libraries(VoltaOS PRIVATE Qt6::Multimedia PkgConfig::LIBUSB PkgConfig::AVCODEC)

# The on-screen keyboard no longer uses the official "skin system" of Qt
# Virtual Keyboard (InputPanel + external/qrc KeyboardStyle) — it turned out to be
# broken (known bug like QTBUG-108536: the style is resolved but never
# instantiated). The keyboard is now hand-drawn in
# qml/VoltaInputPanel.qml using the low-level components
# (InputContext/InputEngine), so there is no need to copy or compile
# any custom style anymore: Qt6::VirtualKeyboard stays linked only to
# provide these low-level components.

if(Qt6WaylandCompositor_FOUND)
    target_link_libraries(VoltaOS PRIVATE Qt6::WaylandCompositor)
    target_compile_definitions(VoltaOS PRIVATE HAVE_WAYLAND_COMPOSITOR)
    message(STATUS "Qt Wayland Compositor trovato — Firefox embedding abilitato")
else()
    message(STATUS "Qt Wayland Compositor NON trovato — installare con Qt Maintenance Tool per Firefox embedding")
endif()

# Interface translations (source texts in English, files i18n/volta_<lang>.ts):
# compiled to .qm and included in the executable (:/i18n/). To update the extracted texts:
#   cmake --build . --target update_translations
qt_add_translations(VoltaOS
    TS_FILES i18n/volta_it.ts i18n/volta_es.ts i18n/volta_fr.ts i18n/volta_pt.ts
    RESOURCE_PREFIX /i18n
    SOURCES ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/qml ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/src/nav/NavigationManager.cpp ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/src/core/SetupManager.cpp ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/src/carlink/CarlinkDongle.cpp ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/src/core/CarModelManager.cpp
    INCLUDE_DIRECTORIES ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/qml)

set_target_properties(VoltaOS PROPERTIES
    WIN32_EXECUTABLE TRUE
    MACOSX_BUNDLE TRUE
)
